statement.text: Let <math>M=(S,r)</math> be a loopless [[wikipedia:matroid|matroid]] of rank ''k'' whose ground set can be partitioned into ''k'' bases. Is it true that no matter how we partition ''S'' into sets of size ''k'', the partition will have ''k-1'' disjoint transversals that are bases?
